messages:
Iris (PM): Noticing a pattern in support tickets: console 'Docs' links frequently land at the docs root. Users expect the specific control section. Can we tighten up deep-linking?

Ravi (Design): Agreed. The sidecar link is often just /docs/console. We should link to anchors on the specific page so users don't have to hunt. Also mobile header hides the target so UX feels broken.

Leah (Docs): Our current anchor generation is fragile because it derives from headings. When copy changes, fragments shift. Solution: authors add explicit IDs in markdown (kebab-case).

Sam (DevEx): Implementation plan: docs team to add `{#anchor-name}` to key headings; console will use canonical format: `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/<page>#<anchor-name>`. We'll add a small preview API so the sidecar can show an excerpt.

Priya (Support): Please confirm canonical format so KB snippets are consistent. Right now some agents paste different variants.

Iris (PM): Canonical format = `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/<page>#<kebab-anchor>`. Include that in PR descriptions and the support KB.

Ben (A11y): A11y checklist: when landing on an anchor, ensure the heading receives focus (tabindex="-1" and focus()). Announce arrival via role="status" if necessary. Also avoid using only visual cues.

Ravi (Design): UX detail: add a ~72px offset when scrolling to the fragment to account for sticky nav. Smooth scroll + a brief highlight animation helps users orient.

Leah (Docs): I'll add stable IDs to the highest-traffic pages this sprint and publish a short author guide recommending kebab-case and not changing IDs lightly. I'll also add redirects for renamed anchors.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add `/api/docs/anchor-preview?page=...&anchor=...` that returns title+short excerpt (cache TTL 24h). If anchor not found, return 404 and console shows toast: "Section moved — opening Docs home" with a search link.

Priya (Support): For the toast please include keyboard dismiss and ensure screen readers announce it. Also add sample links for common queries so I can update canned replies.

Iris (PM): Owners: Leah = stable-anchors, Sam = preview-api + fallback toast, Ravi = scroll offset & highlight, Ben = a11y review, Priya = KB updates. I'll add a QA ticket to validate 4 deep links (desktop + mobile) including SR behavior.

Ravi (Design): I'll prototype the offset + highlight and add the microcopy: "Open docs for this control (new tab)" for the inline link action.

Leah (Docs): I'll open the anchor PR with examples of the canonical format and a small redirect map. Will add CI lint that flags headings missing explicit IDs when referenced.

Sam (DevEx): ETA: API branch + mocks by mid-week so design can iterate. Will include sample curl and JSON responses in the PR.

Ben (A11y): I'll review the PRs and QA steps. Please include keyboard-only flows in the checklist (open link, land, press tab).

Iris (PM): Thanks everyone. Ping me when the QA ticket exists and Leah's PR is ready — we'll schedule a tiny console patch to update copy + deep links.

Priya (Support): Thanks! I'll wait for the canonical link list to update KBs.

Leah (Docs): Noted. Closing thread for now.
